_about: 成语接龙's dictionary (games/jinchat-games.js dictOf), derived offline by tools/chengyu-list.py. `words`: the commonest four-character idioms, the commonest first, one space between — the person plays, hints and deals the choices from these alone. `more`: every other idiom he may say, grouped by first character (the head, then the other three characters of each). His idiom must be in either, unused, and start with the last character of the one before. Sources: THUOCL_chengyu.txt (清华大学开放中文词库, THUNLP), mapull/chinese-dictionary idiom.json (码谱, built on pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua), and a hand-kept supplement of standard idioms they lack (定国安民, 听风是雨; 2026-11-04). The word lists only.
